envs_agree_note: native and native_nodevtools report byte-identical {cases: 141, suites: 17, all_passed: true} pairs. Measured reason: no test file under test/native/avr/ references DEV_TOOLS or CMD_DEV_* anywhere, so no suite compiles a conditional RUN_TEST case under -D DEV_TOOLS; both environments' test_filter blocks in platformio.ini carry the same 17 entries. Consequence for Phase 124: MERGE-06's wording ('pio test -e native and -e native_nodevtools report the BASE-01 case and suite counts') is satisfiable exactly as worded against this baseline. No amendment to MERGE-06 should be requested — D-04's feared live risk (the two envs legitimately diverging) did not materialise.

warnings.counting_command: pio test -e <env> 2>&1 | grep -cE 'warning: *"[^"]+" +redefined'  # macro-redefinition count; grep -cE 'warning:' for the total (identical on both native envs: 360 == 360, i.e. every warning on native is a macro redefinition, none is any other kind)
warnings.note: The 360 macro-redefinition warnings on each native env are a characterised pre-existing count, present on beta at 5c9160a before any v1.23 work, caused by each suite's own test/native/avr/<suite>/avr/pgmspace.h host shim defining 8 macros (PSTR, memcpy_P, pgm_read_byte, pgm_read_dword, pgm_read_ptr, pgm_read_word, strcpy_P, strlen_P) which ArduinoFake's own .pio/libdeps/native/ArduinoFake/src/arduino/pgmspace.h then redefines across 45 translation units -- 8 x 45 = 360, verified by per-macro breakdown (45 occurrences each). It is not a regression and not damage. Deduplicating those 17 suite-local shims would touch 17 suite directories, breaching this phase's 'no firmware code moves' boundary; that remediation (RESEARCH Option B) was considered and rejected by the operator in favor of Option A: an exact-zero rule on the three AVR envs (already true) plus this watermark on the two native envs.
